name: Hana
self_text: I’m Hana, in my 50s, from Australia, and I prefer not to say my gender. I love swing dancing; I move to music and feel alive. I mainly play Tidewatch on PC and usually queue for casual matches. I chat via text or voice, and I’m happy to coach others when I can. I’m free Saturday afternoons, Sunday mornings, or weekday evenings. I enjoy the friendly community vibe and the challenge of strategy games. When I’m not gaming, I spin around on the dance floor.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into Hollow Lantern, you are the one who gets coached by me, and you are available any of Saturday afternoon | Sunday morning | weekday evenings; I’d strongly prefer that you are into casual matches, though it’s not a requirement.
